comment: Hyphenation patterns from hyph-utf8, one gzip'd UTF-8 file per language: the patterns space-separated on the first line, the exceptions (hyphens marking breaks) on the second. Regenerated with src/scripts/hyphenationPatterns.ts, which also writes src/core/text/hyphenation/languages.generated.ts. licenceText is the licence block of each pattern file's own header, verbatim.
